title: Seal dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#c9eef7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='18' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#a9def0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='3' fill='#1a2a44'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='3' fill='#1a2a44'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='1' fill='#e8faff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1' fill='#e8faff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a7a94'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 45 54 41' stroke='#3a7a94' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='37' y1='39' x2='30' y2='37' stroke='#e8faff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='42' x2='30' y2='43' stroke='#e8faff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='39' x2='70' y2='37' stroke='#e8faff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='42' x2='70' y2='43' stroke='#e8faff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left flipper raised up -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='44' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#5fb3d1' transform='rotate(-35 20 44)'/>
  <!-- right flipper raised up -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='44' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#5fb3d1' transform='rotate(35 80 44)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 78 Q84 74 88 84 Q80 82 76 82 Z' fill='#5fb3d1'/>
  <!-- dancing feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3a7a94'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3a7a94'/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <path d='M14 60 Q10 56 14 52' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 60 Q90 56 86 52' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 72 Q14 70 15 66' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 72 Q86 70 85 66' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='3' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <path d='M30 12 Q36 14 33 18' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='3' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <rect x='74' y='8' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#f7d94c'/>
  <path d='M74 8 Q80 10 77 14' stroke='#f7d94c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
</svg>
